# Andrii Bondarenko

> Personal website of Andrii Bondarenko, Ukrainian composer, pianist and music researcher.

## About

Andrii Bondarenko is a Ukrainian composer, pianist and researcher of music.
His professional interests include contemporary music, electronic music,
music education, music technology and Ukrainian musical culture.
